answer: Bonded sponsorship with reputation decay stops fakes. A newcomer needs a sponsor who locks 200 credits, checked by a beacon draw. The newcomer starts on a low terrace, gains full weight through verified work, and idle standing decays 5 percent per epoch. A sponsor backing fakes loses half the bond, so each fake needs a fresh 200-credit bond: 1,000 fakes lock 200,000 credits linearly. The failure mode is sponsor rental, defeated because rented sponsors still lose their own bond. Every newcomer docks at the same jetty. Honest sponsors recover one bond after clean work.
